subject: Availability mosaic — demo orchestration & stakeholder alignment

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@polaris-energy.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@polaris-energy.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Availability mosaic — demo orchestration & stakeholder alignment

Hi Priya / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can align calendars and add the right stakeholders to the demo: 

Summary (30s)
- Discovery: Polaris is focused on inference cost predictability across multi-cloud and bringing the inference runtime behind your VPC for regulated workloads.
- Priority blockers: security evidentiary review, procurement path for reserved capacity, and a platform-eng validation for integration with your service mesh.

Proposed next step
- 60–75 minute technical demo + platform Q&A (we'll include a short procurement <> pricing primer at the end).

Availability windows (your timezone):
- Tue Mar 23, 10:00–11:15 PT
- Wed Mar 24, 14:00–15:15 PT
- Thu Mar 25, 08:30–09:45 PT (early window)

Who I'd like on the call from your side: a security lead (for SOC2/SAML/KMS discussion), someone from procurement, and a platform engineer who owns infra integrations. From our side I'll bring Marissa (security/compliance), Karthik (solutions + SSO/infra), and myself.

Can you confirm which of the windows works and the names/emails for the two additional stakeholders so we can send calendar invites? I can also shift to an alternate time if the team needs a different day.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the right people in the room.

—
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

Rafael —

Appreciate the clear recap. Both windows on March 23 and 24 look promising for our group but we need to loop in a couple of other folks before we lock the invite:

- Security: Priya (me) is coordinating — I'll add our security engineer and ask them to review a quick SOC2 snapshot ahead of the demo.
- Procurement: Samir will lead the procurement piece and confirm our buying path.
- Platform: Requesting we bring in Anika Mehta (platform eng) — she'll validate network and service-mesh requirements.

Quick asks: can you share a short SOC2 evidence snapshot and a proposed agenda (incl. pricing primer) so I can brief internal folks? If you can do that today, I'll get back with final participant names and confirm the March 23, 10:00 PT slot by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Priya Shah

Polaris Energy

Looping in from the security side. Thanks Rafael for the agenda — attaching a short SOC2 snapshot and a one-page runbook we use for VPC deployments (both redacted). The SOC2 snapshot shows the control families most customers ask about during initial evaluation; it is intentionally short so platform security has the right context ahead of the demo.

Also adding two small notes for orchestration expectations:
- We will demonstrate a mock VPC private-control-plane setup and SAML-based SSO during the demo.
- For procurement: we will allocate ~10 mins at the end to walk reserved capacity tiers so procurement can flag the right questions.

Please find attached: SOC2_snapshot.pdf (redacted), demo-agenda-v1.docx (same as Rafael shared).
